response.justification: The candidate has genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS applications), strong low-latency systems background (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby), and solid Linux/DevOps skills. However, the role's primary requirement is modern C++ or Rust, and his C/C++ experience is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint plus a thesis project, with recent years dominated by TypeScript/Node full-stack work. He also lacks direct navigation/routing pipeline experience, making him a partial rather than strong fit.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial platform experience as founder of GISCollective and Green Map GIS apps
Proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work (async I/O, caching, fibers in DLang)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling authorship, and Linux infrastructure skills
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience is minimal and dated (short C/C++ role ending in 2015)
No direct experience with routing engines, routing tiles, or navigation guidance systems
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack TypeScript, away from systems-level data pipeline work
